title: Ask's redlines do at least as well on unseen requests as before the calm redline change
goal: After Ask started choosing measurements in code, its scores on unseen measuring requests fell even though the settings screenshot request got better. Find what kind of measuring request now does worse and fix it, without tuning to any one request.
notes: Measured, not guessed: held-out run 20261021-010309-ask-held-out (before, commit 4514d304) redline group 35.4; after the calm redline (c9200d34) 20261021-050656-ask-held-out redline 19.5; after the follow-up fixes (aa4e3ce3: an empty find_measurements answer says to fall back to find_elements, Ask lays only the ids that answer the request, a redline never drops below three marks) 20261021-055152-ask-held-out redline 19.6. Totals 20.1 / 19.2 / 19.5. Only one baseline run exists, so a lucky baseline is possible: rerun the before commit's held-out once before chasing. A runner may not open Scripts/ask-eval/held-out/ or .ask-eval/held-out-runs/; the user can look at .ask-eval/held-out-runs/20261021-055152-ask-held-out/contact-sheet.png. Ideas not yet checked: requests that name a dimension the plan never measures (a card's width, the title's size), pictures LayoutRead reads poorly (dark app windows, photos), and the prompt sending every measuring request to find_measurements.
acceptance: The held-out redline group is back to at least 35 (Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --set held-out, then report), with the climb settings-measurements case no lower than 47
The cause is named in the task log in general terms (a kind of request or a kind of picture), never as a particular held-out request

log.note: owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

digest 2026-10-21: epic measure-redline -> agent-ask: this is Ask's own score on measuring requests, one of the four focus scenarios. Evidence checked: Scripts/ask-eval.sh report prints held-out 19.5 on 42 cases (run 20261021-055152-ask-held-out), matching the after number here; the 35.4 baseline is one run, so the rerun of the before commit in the notes comes first.

From the scene task, 2026-10-23: the held-out redline group read 31.5 to 37.9 on every run through 20261023-023728-ask-held-out, then 5.5 (20261023-034535-ask-held-out) and 13.2 (20261023-061502-ask-held-out). Neither run changed anything about redlines: the first was a rerun on the same code as 023728, so this looks like a swing in how the built-in model answers redline requests rather than a code change. The climb redline case (settings-measurements) scores 46.6 now (20261023-070523-ask), the same as on 2026-10-22 (46.6, 47.4), so the drop is only in unseen requests. Totals only; no held-out case was opened.

2026-10-23 digest: the redline group read 34.5 on 20261023-023728-ask-held-out and 5.5, 13.2, 13.5, 13.6 on the four held-out runs since, all on the built-in model, which looks like a step, not a swing. Layout fell the same way on the engine change (see ask-on-the-local-model-makes-results-that-look-f). Start by running the held-out set on the Ollama model and the built-in one on the same commit to see whether the engine is the cause.
